summary: The PR introduces a new parameter `cast_to_ndarray` to control whether to cast inputs to ndarrays, which is useful for preserving dtypes in DataFrame outputs. The changes are minimal and well-contained.

issues.description: The new parameter `cast_to_ndarray` is added to `_validate_data`, which is not immediately clear from the function name. This could be confusing for users.
The code could benefit from additional comments explaining the purpose of the `preserve_X` variable and the logic around it.
